note: Both sets capture the four numeric facts (KP, KI, KD, ζφ) with correct values, units and conditions, and all quotes are supported by the page text. Set A simply restates each fact twice (once as 'baseline blade-pitch controller' and once as 'blade-pitch controller'), yielding four redundant, trivial claims with no added information. Set B avoids the duplication and additionally records the stated rationale that ζφ = 0.7 was used to compensate for neglecting negative damping from the generator-torque controller, a condition present in the text (though its quote only covers the value, a minor weakness). Coverage of the important facts is otherwise equal, so B is the cleaner and more faithful set.
